Package com.datastax.driver.core.policies

Class PercentileSpeculativeExecutionPolicy

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.datastax.driver.core.policies.PercentileSpeculativeExecutionPolicy
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SpeculativeExecutionPolicy
    public class PercentileSpeculativeExecutionPolicy
extends Object
implements SpeculativeExecutionPolicy
    A policy that triggers speculative executions when the request to the current host is above a given percentile.

    • Constructor Detail

      • PercentileSpeculativeExecutionPolicy

        public PercentileSpeculativeExecutionPolicy​(PercentileTracker percentileTracker,
                                            double percentile,
                                            int maxSpeculativeExecutions)
        Builds a new instance.
        Parameters:
        percentileTracker - the component that will record latencies. It will get registered with the cluster when this policy initializes.
        percentile - the percentile that a request's latency must fall into to be considered slow (ex: 99.0).
        maxSpeculativeExecutions - the maximum number of speculative executions that will be triggered for a given request (this does not include the initial, normal request). Must be strictly positive.

    • Method Detail

      • getMaxSpeculativeExecutions

        @Beta
public int getMaxSpeculativeExecutions()
        The maximum number of speculative executions this policy triggers for a request, as specified at instantiation. This does not include the initial, normal request.
        Returns:
        the maximum number of speculative executions, always strictly positive.

      • getPercentile

        @Beta
public double getPercentile()
        The latency percentile a request must fall into to be considered slow, as specified at instantiation.
        Returns:
